name: Oven Asado
author: mttwdevelops on based.cooking

ingredients.item: Beef chuck short ribs (bone in preferrably)
Celusal BBQ Salt - Iodized (including the specific type of salt due to smaller salt grains not working well)

steps: Take beef out of fridge and let thaw or reach near room temperature
[OPTIONAL] Rinse each end of the beef to get rid of any remaining bone fragments from when the meat was cut
Pat all sides of beef dry with a paper towel
Salt each side of the beef generously, salt will drip off of the meat due to the fat as the meat cooks
Place beef on a rack and place in oven bone-side down, and be sure to add a tray below the rack to catch all the fat that drips off
20 minutes into cooking, flip each piece over (should be bone-side top now)
After another 20 minutes, flip each piece again
Take out of the oven after a total of 40 - 45 minutes, and let rest for 5 - 10 minutes
